We are hiring on behalf of our reputed CA firm client for a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 6+ years of post-qualification experience in Indirect Taxation, particularly GST advisory, statutory compliance, and litigation.

• Experience in GST compliance, advisory, and litigation.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and relevant accounting and tax software.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, client-handling, and team-management skills.

Candidate Profile

Job Roles & Responsibilities:

Responsible for managing and ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely financial reporting for one or more legal entities within the sub-region. The role supports statutory, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements while partnering closely with the CFO, Company Finance Manager, auditors, and key business stakeholders to deliver high-quality financial reporting and control.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Close Management

- Coordinate and oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities for assigned legal entities.

- Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting in compliance with IFRS, Ind AS, local GAAP, Companies Act requirements, and Group accounting policies.

- Review journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial statements to ensure completeness and accuracy.

- Support consolidation and reporting requirements for group and management reporting.

Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

- Prepare and coordinate statutory financial statements in collaboration with the Company Finance Manager.

- Ensure compliance with Companies Act, SEBI regulations, stock exchange reporting requirements, and other applicable statutory regulations.

- Coordinate filing requirements, disclosures, and regulatory submissions related to listed entity obligations.

- Monitor changes in accounting standards and regulatory requirements and drive implementation as required.

Governance, Controls & Audit

- Ensure compliance with corporate governance requirements and internal control frameworks, including IFC/SOX (where applicable).

- Coordinate internal, statutory, tax, and regulatory audits and serve as the key finance contact for auditors.

- Drive timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.

- Support risk assessment and control monitoring activities across the reporting process.

Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary finance interface for the Company Finance Manager, CFO, Corporate Finance, and external stakeholders.

- Partner with business teams to provide financial insights, accounting guidance, and reporting support.

- Support Board, Audit Committee, and leadership reporting requirements through preparation of high-quality financial analyses and presentations.

Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Support CFO and senior management with profitability analysis, margin reviews, working capital reporting, and quarterly board packs.

- Drive process standardization, automation, and reporting improvements through SKF Business Excellence and digital initiatives.

- Lead initiatives focused on improving reporting quality, compliance, efficiency, and control effectiveness.

- Actively contribute to finance transformation projects, ERP enhancements, and process optimization initiatives.

- Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Finance, Accounting, and Controllership functions.

- Demonstrated experience within:

- Financial Accounting & Reporting

- Financial Controlling

- Statutory Compliance

- Audit Management

- Corporate Governance

- Listed Company Reporting Environment

Competency Profile

- Solid experience in a listed company environment.

- In-depth knowledge of Ind AS, IFRS, Companies Act, and regulatory reporting requirements.

- Strong understanding of financial close, consolidation, and statutory reporting processes.

- Experience managing internal and external audits.

- Knowledge of Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and governance frameworks.

- Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and business partnering skills.

- Proven ability to identify and implement process improvements.

- Advanced ERP knowledge (SAP/S4HANA preferred).

- Strong communication, presentation, and board-reporting capabilities.

Role Success Criteria

- Timely and accurate financial, statutory, and regulatory reporting.

- Zero material audit findings and strong compliance adherence.

- Effective stakeholder engagement with CFO, auditors, and business leadership.

- Continuous improvement in reporting quality, controls, and automation.

- Demonstrates ownership, accountability, collaboration, and a strong team-first mindset.

Company Description SNR & Associates is a firm of Chartered Accountants established in 1983, formerly known as Nitin Parekh & Associates. The firm combines partners with over four decades of professional experience and younger partners with a dynamic, growth-oriented outlook and global ambitions. It provides audit and assurance, taxation, merger and acquisition consulting, succession planning, and advisory services to a wide range of clients, including manufacturing, e-commerce, financial services, real estate, and non-profit organizations. The firm’s mission is to deliver timely, professional, proactive, independent, and innovative services by identifying effective solutions for clients.
Role Description This Chartered Accountants Articleship is an internship role based on-site in Pune. The articleship trainee will assist in statutory and internal audits, tax computations, and preparation of working papers and documentation. • Good analytical and numerical skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
• High level of integrity, professional attitude, and willingness to learn in a fast-paced, client-focused setting.
• Ability to manage time effectively, handle multiple assignments, and meet deadlines.
• Prior exposure through internships or practical training in accounting or audit is beneficial but not mandatory.

Production/Application Support Engineer – Capital Markets (Securities Finance)

As the world works and lives faster, FIS is leading the way. Our fintech solutions touch nearly every market, company and person on the planet. Our teams are inclusive and diverse. Job Title: Head – Finance & Accounts (Chartered Accountant)

Location: Pune – MH

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: 10–15 years

About the Company

DDE ULTRA is a pioneering provider of ultra-high purity process utility systems serving the semiconductor, PV Solar and other high-tech industries. We specialize in designing, manufacturing and installing complex utility systems and turnkey solutions.

We are seeking an Experienced Chartered Accountant (CA) to independently lead the complete Finance & Accounts function, ensuring financial control, compliance, accurate reporting, effective cost management and sound financial decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
• Take end-to-end ownership of accounting, finance operations, monthly and annual book closures, and finalization of accounts.
• Prepare and review financial statements, cash-flow reports, MIS and management dashboards, present key financial insights to senior management.
• Lead annual budgeting, periodic budget forecasting and financial planning across departments and projects.
• Conduct budget-versus-actual variance analysis, investigate deviations and recommend corrective actions.
• Manage cost control and optimization, including project costs, material, manpower, overheads and operating expenses; monitor cost overruns and profitability.
• Oversee cash flow, working capital, fund planning, receivables, payables, banking relationships and facilities such as BGs and LCs, wherever applicable.
• Manage direct and indirect taxation, including GST, TDS and income tax, ensuring timely filings, reconciliations and resolution of notices.
• Lead statutory, internal and tax audits; coordinate with auditors and consultants and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
• Oversee project accounting, project-wise costing, billing, revenue recognition, work-in-progress, retention and profitability reporting.
• Establish and strengthen financial policies, internal controls, approval mechanisms, accounting procedures and compliance calendars.
• Lead and guide the Accounts & Finance team, review deliverables and ensure timely and accurate completion of activities.
• Coordinate with projects, procurement, stores, HR, sales and other teams on budgets, costs, collections, payments and financial matters.

Technical Skills
• Strong knowledge of accounting standards, financial reporting, finalization of accounts and taxation.
• Expertise in budgeting, forecasting, budget-versus-actual variance analysis and cost management.
• Strong understanding of cash flow, treasury, working capital, project costing and profitability analysis.
• Hands-on experience in GST, TDS, income tax, statutory compliance and audit management.
• Knowledge of internal financial controls, risk management and financial process improvement.
• Proficiency in ERP / SAP / Tally and advanced MS Excel; ability to prepare MIS and management reports.

If you are GREAT in the above, not just good, then we need you in our Team.

Qualifications & Skills
• Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
• 10–15 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably in engineering, manufacturing, EPC or project-based organizations.
• Demonstrated ability to independently manage the complete finance function, including accounting, taxation, audits, banking and statutory compliance.
• Proven experience in annual budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, cost control and project profitability management.
• Experience in financial reporting, cash-flow and working-capital management, internal controls and team leadership.
• Strong analytical, decision-making, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with high integrity and accountability.

Preferred Industry Background
• Engineering, manufacturing and industrial organizations.
• Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) companies.
• Project-based engineering, infrastructure and turnkey solution providers.
• Semiconductor, PV Solar, process engineering and industrial utility industries.

Additional Information
• This is a senior-level role with independent ownership of the organization's Finance & Accounts function.
• The candidate must combine hands-on financial management with leadership-level planning, reporting and decision support.
• Experience in managing finance for a growing engineering, manufacturing or EPC business will be an advantage.

Manager - Financial Planning and Analysis About SKF SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence. SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms. To know more, please visit : www.skf.com /in About Industrial Markets The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising. Industrial customers aim to improve operational efficiency while prioritising quality, reliability, and value collaborations that demonstrate a commitment to customer satisfaction and address their evolving needs. At SKF, we provide industry-leading engineering solutions and technologies to industrial market that consistently deliver reliability and efficiency in their day-to-day operations. We cater to a range of industrial sectors, including heavy industries, wind, metals, railways, and general machinery, and help customers achieve their key objectives, depending on their specific application needs and challenges around the machines and equipment. SKF Purpose Statement Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow. By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet JOB DESCRIPTION Position Title: Manager – FP&A Reports To: India Industrial Controller Role Type: Team Management Location: Pune Key Responsibilities Business planning, budgeting and forecasting: Prepare the annual business plan and monthly, quarterly, and rolling forecasts. Coordinate the planning and monthly outlook processes for the Industrial Business. Consolidate, review, and analyse forecasts in Anaplan or other approved reporting tools. Provide clear actual-versus-forecast analysis by month and quarter. Mid- and long-range planning: Develop the mid- and long-range financial plan. Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate strategic options through scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis. Financial performance analysis : Conduct detailed contribution-margin, gross-margin, and PLP analysis. Assess price, mix, and volume movements by segment, SKU, and customer against the prior year, including PS and LPC impacts. Customer and order-book analysis: Identify high-, low-, and negative-margin customers and explain the key drivers of performance. Analyse the order book and operating margin by segment. Pricing governance: Support the business with pricing and margin analysis and simulations. Track OEM price increases by segment. Maintain a central repository of customer ARCs and monitor price-escalation clauses and related commercial exposure. Restatement: Complete the annual restatement process in accordance with SKF requirements and the agreed timetable. Inventory management: Monitor OEM inventory and work with KAMs to deliver reduction plans. Review dead and slow-moving stock, assess the adequacy of obsolescence provisions, and coordinate liquidation actions with KAMs and segment heads. Develop and monitor targeted inventory-reduction initiatives. Business performance support: Provide structured communications, timelines, and guidance to segment heads. Deliver profitability analysis by segment, product, and customer. Investigate errors affecting India results and coordinate corrective action with the relevant stakeholders.
